primary_geometry_basis: georeferenced organizer raster snapped to OpenStreetMap

sources.description: Christinehof start/finish; approximately 5 km; first ~3 km easier roads/tracks and last ~2 km narrower technical trail

sources.role: independent full-resolution geometry-length cross-check of the organizer line

limitations: No accessible organizer GPX or verified participant GPX has been found for this course version.
The published asset is a reconstruction: route choice comes from the georeferenced organizer raster and vector geometry is snapped to OSM where supported.

The full-resolution organizer-raster skeleton measures 5.545 km versus 5.481 km for the OSM-snapped route; the 64 m difference is retained as reconstruction uncertainty rather than forced to a nominal 5.0 km.
The older coarse 62-vertex 5.002 km prototype was an under-sampled feasibility measurement and is not used as the preferred distance estimate.
